title: Inventory Visibility, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Inventory Visibility agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 8 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Inventory Visibility Stores list.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Downtown Flagship (StoreId STR-001), with City Chicago.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Inventory Visibility Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 8 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Inventory Planner
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Inventory Planner, summarize the store snapshot and verification boundary.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Inventory Planner; Inventory Visibility Snapshot; no stock is reserved. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Store Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Store Manager, identify urgent review candidates without issuing transfer or replenishment commands.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Store Manager; Draft Stock Review; Review transfer candidate. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Inventory Planner
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Inventory Planner, show the fourteen-day replenishment scenario and its assumptions.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Draft Replenishment Plan; 14-day supply; Estimated Total Replenishment Cost. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Category Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Category Manager, compare the channel planning scenario without reserving any stock.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Category Manager; Channel Allocation Scenario; do not reserve units. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Inventory Visibility: 8 read-only tabs from the same lists. 4 fictional records, including Downtown Flagship (StoreId STR-001), with City Chicago.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Inventory Visibility Stores from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload stores.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set StoreId, City, State, Type to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep CapacitySqft as Number. Name the list Inventory Visibility Stores. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Downtown Flagship (StoreId STR-001), with City Chicago.

steps.title: Create Inventory Visibility Warehouses from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload warehouses.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set WarehouseId, City, State to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep CapacityPallets as Number. Name the list Inventory Visibility Warehouses. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 2 fictional records, including Central Distribution Center (WarehouseId WH-CENTRAL), with City Romeoville.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Inventory Visibility Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Inventory Visibility Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the eight list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_inventory-visibility-rules-and-safety.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the stores tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Inventory Visibility Stores; name the tool Get store records.
steps.expected: Get store records is listed under Tools.

steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Inventory Visibility Warehouses; name the tool Get warehouse records.

steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: inventory-visibility-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 8 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Inventory Visibility Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Inventory Visibility Stores" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Inventory Visibility Warehouses" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Inventory Visibility SKUS" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Inventory Visibility Inventory" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Inventory Visibility Safety Stock" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Inventory Visibility Lead Times Days" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Inventory Visibility Channel Demand" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Inventory Visibility Daily Sell Through" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 8 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Inventory Visibility Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Inventory Visibility Stores tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 4 fictional records, including Downtown Flagship (StoreId STR-001), with City Chicago.
